market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces headwinds from iron ore crash, oil-driven fuel inflation, and Fed uncertainty. Index likely range-bound with sector rotation away from materials into energy, gold, and healthcare. 'Stock shock' narrative may trigger 3-5% pullback in ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift toward energy transition, healthcare consolidation, and AI-driven productivity. Housing correction and immigration policy changes will pressure banks and REITs over 6-12 months. Gold and critical minerals (graphite, rare earths) offer durable upside. Superannuation reform could redirect capital flows.
